events.did: Hid the rusted bike back amid the brush and started toward the cabin
events.quote_anchor: She hid the rusted bike back amid the brush and started toward the house.

events.did: Mistook the stranger by the steps for Victor and dropped to the ground behind Mitch's unsplit log pile
events.quote_anchor: Sydney dropped to the ground like a stone, landing behind a pile of logs Mitch had yet to split.

events.did: Gripped the axe at the edge of the woodpile and failed to pry it free
events.quote_anchor: She wrapped her hand around it, sliding her fingers into his grooves. But when she tried to pry it free, it didn’t even budge.

events.did: Drew the knife out of her boot and got to her feet facing the stranger
events.quote_anchor: The knife in her boot felt pitifully small, but she drew it anyway, keeping the blade out of sight

events.did: Broke out of the cabin's back door and put his body in front of Syd with his teeth bared
events.quote_anchor: the massive black dog came barreling toward them, moving faster than he had in years

events.did: Drove the pickup around the corner and hopped out to face the stranger
events.quote_anchor: Just then, the pickup came whipping around the corner, and down the drive, throwing up gravel and dirt.

events.did: Gave his name to Mitch and held out his hand
events.quote_anchor: “Sorry to bother you all,” he said, holding out a hand. “Name’s Noah.”

events.did: Told Syd to pack her bags because staying was not worth the risk
events.quote_anchor: Neither do I. But staying isn’t worth the risk.

relations.did: Promised Syd the two of them would look after each other, the deal they had
relations.quote_anchor: You look after me, and I’ll look after you. That was the deal.

relations.did: Told Syd he was not an EO and could not control bodies or minds or bring the dead back
relations.quote_anchor: “You’re right. I’m not an EO. I can’t control people’s bodies, or their minds, or bring them back from the dead.

relations.did: Was the father of a daughter named Haley
relations.quote_anchor: The man—Noah—bobbed his head. “Not a bad thing, to be cautious. That’s what I tell my daughter.”

relations.did: Had taken away the pain of Dominic Rusher, a soldier broken by his time at war
relations.quote_anchor: But once Victor had taken away his pain, he’d carried himself the way this guy did now, straight-backed and strong.

numbers.did: Stopped ten feet away from Syd
numbers.quote_anchor: The stranger stopped, ten feet away, holding up a hand to shield his eyes as if he wasn’t already wearing shades.

numbers.did: Was not thirty yards from the nearest door
numbers.quote_anchor: she was already inside the house. Not thirty yards from the nearest door.
He died two summers back. Would have bought the place myself, but I was deployed.
